name: South Bay Galleria
description: South Bay Galleria is a three-level enclosed regional shopping center in Redondo Beach, California, featuring over 140 retailers including anchor stores Macy's and Kohl's, plus an AMC Dine-In Theatres with 16 screens. The mall serves as a premier shopping and entertainment destination for the South Bay communities of Los Angeles, offering a comprehensive mix of national retailers, dining options, and family-friendly amenities. With extended holiday hours and year-round events, South Bay Galleria provides a welcoming environment for shopping, dining, and entertainment.
demographics: South Bay Galleria serves a diverse, middle to upper-middle-class demographic in the South Bay region of Los Angeles County, drawing families and young professionals aged 25-54 with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The trade area encompasses the affluent beach communities of Redondo Beach, Manhattan Beach, Hermosa Beach, and neighboring Torrance, attracting visitors who value convenience and a mix of value-oriented and mid-tier retailers. The center appeals to suburban families seeking entertainment options like AMC Theatres alongside everyday shopping needs, with a customer base that balances practical purchases with leisure activities.
summary: South Bay Galleria is a three-level enclosed regional mall offering over 140 stores, department store anchors, an AMC Dine-In theatre, and diverse dining options for the South Bay communities.
